resources.string: Control your phone with air gestures, without touching the screen.

Air Sensor lets people who cannot reliably touch the screen operate their phone hands-free. Hand and face movements seen by the front camera are turned into swipes, taps, pinch-to-zoom, Back, Home, Recents and app launches, so the phone can be used without touching it. This service performs those gestures for you. It does not read the content of your screen.
Puts an Air gestures switch in the pull-down shade, next to Wi-Fi. Banking and UPI apps refuse to pay while gesture control is on — the tile is the fastest way to switch it off and back.
A small dot over other apps, confirming gestures are being watched. Tap it to come back here.
A blue dot follows your pointed finger, and holding still taps where it sits. Replaces finger-swipe scrolling while it is on.
Releases the camera while the screen is off — by far the biggest battery saving available. Wave gestures keep working either way.
Opens Android\'s battery settings. Find Air Sensor in the list and set it to unrestricted, or gesture control will be shut down in the background.
